original.statement: The Go module path changed to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 (and crossplane-runtime/v2); Go consumers must update go.mod and all import statements.

corrected.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 moves its Go module paths to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2. Code that imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime must update the module path in go.mod and every import statement when updating to v2+.

decision.reason: [ev-d241daaf3863] says Go code that imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime must update its go.mod module path and every import statement to the /v2 paths. That is a mandatory operator step, so the subject migration:go-module-path-v2 with type migration-required is right. However, migration-required takes no before/after values, and the text never states the old path "github.com/crossplane/crossplane" as a literal. I dropped the inferred before/after values.
